# Large-scale foundation model on single-cell transcriptomics

## Takeaway

scFoundation pretrains a large model over human single-cell profiles and exposes embeddings and task-specific workflows. It is best treated as an auditable optional branch after a reproducible count-matrix baseline is complete.

## Input and output

- Input: expression matrix or .h5ad plus the exact model weights/API version.
- Output: embeddings, enhancement or downstream task predictions.
- Record: gene vocabulary, checkpoint, hardware, preprocessing and baseline metrics.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02305-7
- Code and weights/API: https://github.com/biomap-research/scFoundation
- Turnkey entry: python/03_scFoundation_embedding_template.py.

## Limitation

Large memory and model-license constraints can make this unsuitable for routine analysis. Preserve the classical analysis as the primary interpretable result.
